_help: Placeholder cards shown before results exist. fetch.py adds each as a too_early race with 0 votes unless a live race with the same title (or category+district) exists; the live race replaces it. Candidates are the general-election candidates from Ballotpedia (fetched 2026-10-21; the MO SOS site returned Cloudflare 403). Senate: 17 even-numbered districts (Ballotpedia: 'Seats up: 17'). County cards (category county_stl / county_stc) also carry 'county' and 'match' (regexes on the live feed contest title); a live county race in the same tab that matches replaces the placeholder.

races.title: Amendment 3
races.description: Legislature-referred: repeal the 2024 abortion-rights amendment, allow abortion only in limited cases, and ban gender transition procedures for minors.

races.title: Amendment 6
races.description: Citizen initiative: make initiative/referendum a fundamental right and bar the legislature from changing voter-passed initiatives without 80% of both chambers plus voter approval.

races.title: Amendment 7
races.description: Legislature-referred: create a permanent state endowment fund and eliminate state-imposed taxes once its earnings can replace them.

races.title: Amendment 8
races.description: Legislature-referred: require county sheriffs to be elected and limit their removal to quo warranto.

races.title: Proposition A
races.description: Referendum on the 2025 congressional map (HB 1): Yes keeps the new map, No repeals it.
